The scientific consensus is that there is no link between the MMR vaccine and autism.

Multiple large-scale studies across different populations have found no association. The original 1998 paper suggesting a connection was retracted due to serious methodological flaws and ethical violations, and its author lost his medical license.

Major organizations including the WHO, CDC, American Academy of Pediatrics, and National Academy of Medicine all confirm MMR does not cause autism. The purported link has been thoroughly debunked.
